description: Source code for constant and enum variable tracking in Dynamo, including classes ConstantVariable and EnumVariable for handling Python literals, immutable types, and enum instances within the Dynamo compilation framework.

classes.name: ConstantVariable
classes.description: Variable tracker for Python literals and immutable types, supporting collection types and various method calls.

classes.name: EnumVariable
classes.description: Variable tracker for enum.Enum and enum.IntEnum instances, providing value tracking and attribute access.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create ConstantVariable or collection variables based on input value.

methods.name: as_proxy
methods.description: Returns the value suitable for proxying.

methods.name: is_python_constant
methods.description: Indicates this is a Python constant.

methods.name: is_symnode_like
methods.description: Checks if the value is symbol node-like (int or bool).

methods.name: is_constant_match
methods.description: Checks if the value matches any of the provided values.

methods.name: is_constant_none
methods.description: Checks if the value is None.

methods.name: getitem_const
methods.description: Gets item at index or key, returning a ConstantVariable.

methods.name: is_base_literal
methods.description: Checks if an object is a base literal type.

methods.name: is_literal
methods.description: Checks if an object is a literal or collection of literals.

methods.name: unpack_var_sequence
methods.description: Unpacks the variable sequence into a list of VariableTrackers.

methods.name: const_getattr
methods.description: Gets attribute value as a VariableTracker.

methods.name: call_method
methods.description: Calls a method on the constant value, supporting special cases like 'format', 'join', '__iter__', etc.

methods.name: call_tree_map
methods.description: Applies a tree map function over the constant value.

methods.name: call_obj_hasattr
methods.description: Checks if the object has an attribute, returning a ConstantVariable boolean.

methods.name: get_python_hash
methods.description: Returns the hash of the value.
